title: HR Administrator
description:
HR Administrator

Location: Office-based (5 days per week) - SL1
Hours: Full-time, Monday to Friday
Working Hours: 9:00am - 5:00pm (flexibility to work 8:00am - 4:00pm available)
Salary: up to £35,000 per annum

I am recruiting for a proactive and organised HR Administrator to join my clients' growing HR team. This is an excellent opportunity for an HR professional with around 18 months' experience who is looking to further develop their career within a generalist HR environment.

Desirable:

- A chance to develop your career within a successful logistics business.

title: Tenancy Progression Administrator
description:
Tenancy Progression AdministratorReading Build to Rent / Private Rented Sector

The Opportunity

We are currently working with a rapidly growing organisation within the Build to Rent (BTR) and Private Rented Sector (PRS) market, who are looking to appoint a Tenancy Progression Administrator to join their busy Tenancy Operations team in Reading.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and customer-focused administrator to join a growing residential property business and gain valuable experience across the full lettings and tenancy progression process.

The role is central to ensuring applications move efficiently from initial acceptance through to move-in, helping to minimise property void periods, maximise occupancy and deliver an excellent customer experience throughout the journey.

You'll work closely with the Tenancy Progression team, Lettings teams, tenants and external providers, ensuring each application is accurately managed and progressed within the required timescales.

About the Role

As a Tenancy Progression Administrator, you'll provide essential administrative and coordination support throughout the tenancy process.

You'll be responsible for carrying out pre-tenancy checks, progressing applications, completing Right to Rent checks, arranging inventories and check-ins, managing customer communications and ensuring tenancy records are accurate and up to date.

This is a fast-paced and varied role, ideal for someone who enjoys working to deadlines, managing multiple priorities and being part of a collaborative property team.

Previous administration experience is essential, while experience within residential lettings, estate agency or property administration would be advantageous.

Key ResponsibilitiesTenancy Progression
- Support the Tenancy Progression team in successfully progressing applications through to move-in.
- Manage tenancy files from application through to completion, ensuring all required actions are completed.
- Carry out pre-tenancy checks and ensure all necessary information is obtained.
- Conduct Right to Rent checks and calls in line with current requirements.
- Submit and process tenant applications accurately and efficiently.
- Monitor live applications and proactively chase outstanding information.
- Work closely with third-party agents and external providers where required.
- Ensure applications progress within agreed timescales and operational KPIs.

Move-In & Property Coordination
- Schedule inventories, check-ins and cleaning services.
- Coordinate check-in arrangements and ensure tenants receive all relevant information ahead of their move.
- Liaise with internal teams and external suppliers to ensure properties are ready for occupation.
- Help minimise property void periods by ensuring tenancy processes are completed efficiently.
- Maintain accurate records of tenancy progression and upcoming move-ins.

Customer Service
- Provide a high level of customer service throughout the referencing and pre-tenancy process.
- Keep tenants informed of progress via telephone and email.
- Respond promptly and professionally to customer enquiries.
- Manage incoming calls and shared inboxes effectively.
- Identify tenant queries that require specialist assistance and ensure they are directed to the appropriate department.
- Provide clear and supportive communication throughout the customer journey.

Administration & Systems
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date tenancy files, databases and internal systems.
- Ensure all application and tenant information is recorded correctly.
- Monitor outstanding actions and proactively follow up where necessary.
- Support the team in achieving key operational measures, including occupancy and customer satisfaction.
- Maintain confidentiality when handling tenant and business information.
- Assist with additional duties and projects as required by the Tenancy Operations Manager.

About You

We're looking for an organised, proactive and customer-focused administrator who is keen to develop a career within residential property.

You'll be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple applications and deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.

Ideally, you will have:
- Previous experience within an administration role.
- Experience within residential lettings, estate agency or property administration would be advantageous.
- Excellent customer service skills.
- Strong written and verbal communication abilities.
- Exceptional organisation and attention to detail.
- The ability to manage multiple tasks and competing priorities.
- A proactive approach and the confidence to take ownership of tasks.
- Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to find solutions.
- Confidence using databases, CRM systems and Microsoft Office.
- The ability to work independently while also contributing positively to a wider team.
- A willingness to learn and keep up to date with relevant legislation and industry requirements.
- A professional approach to confidential customer and business information.
- A genuine interest in developing a long-term career within the property sector.

title: Lettings Coordinator
description:
Lettings CoordinatorReading Build to Rent / Private Rented Sector

The Opportunity

We are currently working with a rapidly growing and highly regarded organisation within the Build to Rent (BTR) and Private Rented Sector (PRS) market, who are looking to appoint a Lettings Coordinator to join their expanding team in Reading.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a business focused on providing high-quality, new-build family homes across the UK, with a strong emphasis on delivering an exceptional customer experience.

As Lettings Coordinator, you'll play a key role within the lettings function, acting as the first point of contact for prospective residents and managing incoming enquiries from initial interest through to arranging property viewings.

You'll be working in a fast-paced environment where customer service, organisation and attention to detail are essential.

About the Role

As a Lettings Coordinator, you'll be responsible for managing inbound leads and enquiries across a growing residential portfolio.

You'll speak with prospective tenants to understand their requirements, discuss suitable properties, establish affordability and help guide them through the initial stages of the lettings journey.

A key part of the role will be coordinating property viewings with Lettings Consultants, ensuring appointments are arranged efficiently and prospective tenants receive a professional and engaging experience from their first interaction.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in residential lettings, estate agency, property or customer service who is looking to develop their career within the growing BTR sector.

Key ResponsibilitiesLead & Enquiry Management
- Manage incoming enquiries across multiple communication channels, including telephone and email.
- Act as the first point of contact for prospective tenants.
- Respond promptly and professionally to enquiries, providing a high level of customer service.
- Understand prospective tenants' requirements and identify suitable properties.
- Discuss affordability and key property information with prospective tenants.
- Maintain regular communication and follow up with prospective customers.
- Accurately record all lead and customer information within the CRM system.
- Ensure CRM records are kept accurate, complete and up to date.

Customer Experience
- Deliver an exceptional customer experience from the initial enquiry onwards.
- Clearly communicate the benefits and features of the homes and wider rental offering.
- Build rapport with prospective tenants and understand their individual requirements.
- Provide clear, helpful and engaging information via telephone and email.
- Manage customer expectations and ensure all enquiries are dealt with efficiently.
- Represent the organisation professionally at every stage of the customer journey.

Viewing Coordination
- Coordinate and schedule property viewings for the Lettings Consultants.
- Liaise with prospective tenants to arrange suitable viewing appointments.
- Work closely with Lettings Consultants to ensure viewing schedules are managed effectively.
- Optimise viewing arrangements to maximise opportunities for the lettings team.
- Follow up with prospective tenants following viewings where required.
- Keep CRM and internal systems updated with viewing information and outcomes.

Lettings Administration
- Provide administrative support to the wider lettings team.
- Respond to internal and external queries in a timely and professional manner.
- Ensure relevant information is communicated accurately to Lettings Consultants and other stakeholders.
- Support the team with day-to-day lettings processes and activities.
- Identify opportunities to improve processes and overall customer experience.

About You

We're looking for a confident, driven and customer-focused individual who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and is motivated by delivering excellent service.

You may already have experience within residential lettings, estate agency, property, BTR/PRS or customer service, although sector experience is not essential if you can demonstrate the right skills and attitude.

Ideally, you will have:
- Previous experience within residential lettings, estate agency, property or a customer-facing environment.
- BTR or PRS experience would be advantageous but is not essential.
- Excellent customer service skills and a genuine focus on the customer experience.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills.
- Excellent organisation and time-management abilities.
- Confidence communicating with prospective tenants by telephone and email.
- The ability to manage multiple enquiries and priorities simultaneously.
- Strong attention to detail and accurate data-entry skills.
- Experience using CRM or property management systems would be advantageous.
- A proactive approach with the confidence to take ownership of tasks.
- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to find practical solutions.
- The ability to work independently while contributing positively to a wider team.
- A professional approach to handling confidential customer and business information.
- A genuine interest in developing a career within the property and lettings sector.

title: Lettings Coordinator
description:
Lettings & Viewings Coordinator

Reed are looking for a Lettings & Viewings Coordinator to deliver high-quality property viewings and tenant check-ins across a residential portfolio. This is a field-based role focused on creating a positive customer experience, maintaining high presentation standards and supporting occupancy through excellent face-to-face engagement.

What We're Looking For
- 2+ years' experience in lettings, property management, block management or a similar property role.
- Excellent communication and customer service skills.
- Full UK Driving Licence and own vehicle.
- Able to work two evenings per week and occasional Saturdays.
- Organised, proactive and customer-focused.

Key Objectives
- Deliver professional property viewings.
- Convert interest into tenant applications.
- Ensure vacant rooms are viewing-ready.
- Conduct smooth tenant move-in check-ins.
- Maintain a strong pipeline of applicants.

Key Responsibilities

Viewings & Property Presentation
- Conduct property viewings across the portfolio.
- Confirm appointments and reduce no-shows.
- Ensure properties are clean, presentable and ready to show.
- Provide accurate information on properties and tenancy terms.
- Answer applicant questions professionally.

Property Preparation
- Set up and move marketing materials between properties.
- Ensure vacant rooms meet presentation standards.
- Report any property issues identified.

Tenant Check-Ins
- Complete in-person move-in check-ins.
- Introduce tenants to the property and house rules.
- Deliver a smooth and welcoming move-in experience.
- Assist with check-outs and inventories when required.

Applicant & Pipeline Management
- Qualify applicants and assess suitability.
- Maintain accurate records within the CRM.
- Follow up viewing attendees and warm leads.
- Re-engage previous enquiries where appropriate.

Administration
- Respond to enquiries and arrange viewings when required.
- Update CRM systems and activity trackers.
- Monitor viewing and check-in performance.
- Support the wider team with reasonable business requests.

Working Pattern
- Field-based role with regular travel between properties.
- On-site position with no remote or hybrid working.
- Full UK Driving Licence and own vehicle required.
- Travel within approximately a 15-mile radius of Reading.
- Minimum of two evenings per week (finishing at 7:30pm).
- Occasional Saturday working (typically 6-8 hours).

What's Not Included in This Role
- Closing deals or making final tenancy decisions.
- Ongoing tenant management after move-in.
- Compliance or onboarding administration.
- Property maintenance coordination.
- Marketing strategy responsibilities.
- Desk-based, remote or hybrid working.

This role is ideal for an experienced property professional who enjoys being out on the road, meeting people and delivering a first-class viewing and move-in experience.

title: Lettings Coordinator
description:
Key Responsibilities
- Conducting property viewings with prospective tenants
- Meeting and communicating with applicants in a professional and friendly manner

About You

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking for a varied role within the property industry, with the opportunity to develop their experience across the lettings process.

title: Recruitment Account Coordinator
description:
Permanent I Full-time I 5 out of 7 days I On-site

Salary: up to £30,000 per annum + bonus

Have you considered a career in recruitment? You possess drive, ambition, discipline, and structure, but haven't yet had the opportunity to put it all into practice? Come and showcase your potential at Staffline.

The Recruitment Account Opportunity

This is your chance to join the UK's largest recruitment business as a Recruitment Account Coordinator. In this role, you'll be providing temporary workers for our Driving operation in Reading.

To excel in this role, your focus will be on customers, committed to delivering the best service, and a natural problem solver. While experience in on-site recruitment would be beneficial, it's not an essential requirement. If you have transferable skills, we can provide training on all the elements essential for success in this position.

What you'll do as a Recruitment Account Coordinator

This role thrives on pace - helping candidates find the best jobs, solving problems, and enhancing the candidate experience and work environment. It's a wonderfully diverse role that will undoubtedly keep you engaged. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:
- Meeting client deadlines by fulfilling staffing requirements
- Recruitment, selection, and onboarding of workers
- Accurate data input and validation for weekly payroll
- Handling administrative processes such as absences and change requests
- Ensuring compliance and maintaining secure records for audits
- Providing a positive customer experience and efficiently addressing worker queries

The skills you'll develop as a Recruitment Account Coordinator

Throughout your time at Staffline, you'll receive coaching and challenges that will facilitate skill growth. In this role, you can anticipate enhancing skills related to client and relationship management, hiring and staffing processes, and identifying opportunities for performance improvement - among a range of other areas. At Staffline, we actively encourage progression and personal development, with dedicated progression paths for those who join us.

What we need from you

By now, it should be evident that we're dedicated to your development, fair rewards, and encouraging you to excel in your role at Staffline. To succeed in this position, a few things are required:
- Swift adaptation to changing priorities and effective problem-solving skills
- A customer-centric mindset, prioritizing people above all else
- Ideally, experience within the recruitment industry (though not essential)
- A growth mindset, consistently seeking innovative approaches while fulfilling both client and customer needs
- Strong relationship-building abilities, confidently establishing and maintaining connections with clients and customers
- Most importantly, tenacity, drive, flexibility, and a positive attitude toward delivering excellent service.

Diversity and Inclusion: A Core Focus

At Staffline, we are deeply committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe that a diverse team brings different perspectives, ideas, and experiences, enhancing our overall effectiveness and success. We value and celebrate the uniqueness of each individual, and we actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

Intrigued? Why not apply now? Or if you need more information, get in touch.

Note: All candidates must demonstrate their Right to Work in the UK. A full UK driver's license is highly desired for this role.

title: Administrator
description: We are excited to recruit a Band 3 Administrator to support our CAMHS Getting Help and Mental Health Support Team East Berkshire. The role is 30 hours per week, worked 9:00am-5:00pm across agreed days. The days of work are flexible and will be discussed with the successful candidate. Administrators are key to our Trust, supporting our service users and clinicians. In this varied and rewarding role, you will help ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the service by managing referrals, responding to telephone and email enquiries, maintaining accurate records and providing administrative support to the wider team, including Senior Administrators and the Business Support Manager. Berkshire CAMHS is a multi-disciplinary service that supports children and young people's emotional wellbeing and mental health. We value our employees and put people first. We are pioneers in compassionate leadership and Quality Improvement, with a strong commitment to creating a culture where everyone has a voice and where service users and staff collaborate to have a direct impact on the things that matter most. We are looking for someone who is enthusiastic, organised and flexible, with a warm, approachable manner, excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a busy environment. You will support the effective operation of the CAMHS Getting Help and Mental Health Support Team. Providing the required administrative support to ensure that clinical services are delivered efficiently, and children, young people and families receive a seamless and timely service. Working as part of the administrative team to ensure the referrals process is carried out in an accurate and timely manner. You will answer emails and telephone calls, following up actions where required. You will liaise effectively and professionally with all levels of staff, external organisations, and the public, dealing with confidential information in an appropriate manner. You will need to be experienced in taking minutes at meetings, diary management and confident in using the full Microsoft Office suite including Outlook, Word and Excel. You will also be required to work on your own initiative and demonstrate a willingness to help others as a key member of the team. The ability to build effective relationships, with a flexible approach to work is essential. You will be expected to be able to prioritise work and meet deadlines in order to fulfil the requirements of the post. Carry out day-to-day organisation of systems to ensure the smooth running of the administration team. The must haves for this role: 1. NVQ 3 or equivalent qualification/experience 2. Knowledge and experience of office administration procedures 3. Good interpersonal communication and reporting skills 4. Good/advanced IT skills and the ability to navigate around various systems and software packages For further information about the role, please see attached job description and person specification. Your application is your opportunity to demonstrate to us how you meet the requirements of the role. We recognise that AI tools can support accessibility, equity and confidence for applicants. However, its important that examples and responses given in your supporting statement genuinely reflect your own experience and abilities, as these will be explored further during the selection process. AI must not be used to provide misleading or false information during any stage of the application journey. In addition to explaining how you meet the person specification, you must complete your employment history for at least the last five years. Any experience, skills or responsibilities referenced in your supporting statement should be evidenced within your employment history. Applications that do not include sufficient employment history to support the experience claimed may not be shortlisted. We are committed to equal opportunities and welcome applications from all sections of the community. Our commitment to inclusion is reflected in our accreditations: Stonewall Proud Employer, Race Equality Matters Silver Trailblazer, Neurodiversity in Business Corporate Member, Disability Confident Leader, Carer Confident Level 2, and the Armed Forces Covenant Gold Award. Reasonable adjustments will be provided to candidates as needed. We welcome a conversation about flexibility and any other questions you may have. Please don't hesitate to contact Lucy Jacobs on 07929 804504 or email : lucy.jacobs@berkshire.nhs.uk who'll be delighted to help. Please note, if we receive a high number of applications, we may close this role earlier than the advertised closing date, so please submit your application as soon as possible.

title: Administrator

We are primarily based in Bracknell, however, do offer face to assessment and liaise with associated Primary, statutory, and Secondary care services throughout Berkshire. We are innovative, stable and experienced team who offer high level of support with a good balance of home and office-based work. The Team is committed to offering a good work/life balance with opportunities for personal and professional development. We currently have 1 Full-Time (37.5 hours/week) and 1 Part-Time (30.5 hours/week) The post holder will provide a high level of administrative support and maintain effective office processes and procedures in relation to routine and urgent referrals for the Common Point of Entry (CPE). The Role of CPE administrator is set within a busy open plan office along with the ability to work remotely. In return we offer structured supervision, access to training and development as part of your own personal development programme. This is a friendly and supportive team environment within an organisation that truly makes a difference for people with mental health conditions, their families and carers. title: Receptionist/Administrator
description: As the first point of contact for our patients, you will play a vital role in ensuring they receive a welcoming and efficient service. Youll be responsible for managing incoming queries, booking appointments, handling administrative tasks and supporting the clinical team with day-to-day operations. Key Responsibilities Provide a courteous and effective reception service to patients and visitors Answer telephone calls efficiently and direct patients to the appropriate services Manage appointment bookings, including use of triage tools and hub referrals Process patient information accurately using clinical systems Respond to E-consults and email queries in a timely and professional manner Maintain effective communication within the practice team and with external healthcare partners Support other administrative duties as needed, including filing, scanning, and managing shared mailboxes What Were Looking For Excellent communication skills verbal and written Strong organisational skills and attention to detail a must. Ability to multitask, work under pressure and prioritise workload Confident using IT systems (previous EMIS experience is an advantage) Friendly, positive and team-oriented attitude Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and professionalism Flexibility to cover annual leave and absences as required Available for shifts between the hours of 8am and 6pm
